While ON, the skill router is appended t.id: Sedangkan MENGHIDUPKAN, skill router ditambahkan ke setiap request yang diproksikan — Hermes, alat CLI, semua client. Agent memilih skill mana yang akan diambil; teks skill penuh TIDAK dimasukkan ke dalam system prompt.
While ON, the skill router is appended t.ja: ON 中は、スキルルーターがすべてのプロキシ化リクエストに付与されます — Hermes、CLI ツール、すべてのクライアント。エージェントがどのスキルを取得するかを選び、完全なスキルテキストはシステムプロンプトにインライン展開されません。
While ON, the skill router is appended t.ko: 켜져 있는 동안 skill 라우터는 모든 프록시된 요청에 추가됩니다 — Hermes, CLI 도구, 모든 클라이언트. 에이전트가 어떤 스킬을 가져올지 선택하며, 전체 스킬 텍스트는 시스템 프롬프트에 인라인되지 않습니다.
While ON, the skill router is appended t.es: Mientras esté SÍ, el skill router se añade a cada solicitud proxy — Hermes, herramientas CLI, todos los clientes. El agente elige qué skill obtener; el texto completo del skill NO se inserta en el system prompt.
While ON, the skill router is appended t.fr: Tant qu'il est OUI, le skill router est ajouté à chaque requête proxifiée — Hermes, outils CLI, tous les clients. L'agent choisit quel skill récupérer ; le texte complet du skill n'est PAS inséré dans le system prompt.
While ON, the skill router is appended t.de: Solange AN, wird der Skill-Router jeder proxifizierten Anfrage hinzugefügt — Hermes, CLI-Tools, alle Clients. Der Agent wählt aus, welchen Skill er abruft; der vollständige Skill-Text wird NICHT in den System-Prompt eingefügt.
While ON, the skill router is appended t.pt-BR: Enquanto LIGAR, o skill router é anexado a cada request proxificada — Hermes, ferramentas CLI, todos os clientes. O agente escolhe qual skill buscar; o texto completo do skill NÃO é incluído no system prompt.
While ON, the skill router is appended t.zh-CN: 开启时，技能路由会附加到每一个代理请求 — Hermes、CLI 工具、所有客户端。agent 选择要拉取哪个技能；完整技能文本不会内联到系统提示词中。
While ON, the skill router is appended t.ru: Пока ВКЛ, skill router добавляется к каждому прокси-запросу — Hermes, CLI-инструменты, все клиенты. Агент выбирает, какой skill вытащить; полный текст skill НЕ встраивается в системный промпт.
While ON, the skill router is appended t.tr: AÇIKken, skill router her proxy'lenmiş isteğe eklenir — Hermes, CLI araçları, tüm istemciler. Ajan hangi skill'i çekeceğini seçer; tam skill metni system prompt'a satır içi eklenmez.
While ON, the skill router is appended t.vi: Trong khi BẬT, skill router được thêm vào mọi request được proxy — Hermes, công cụ CLI, mọi client. Agent chọn skill nào để lấy; văn bản skill đầy đủ KHÔNG được nhúng vào system prompt.
While ON, the skill router is appended t.th: ในระหว่างที่เปิด skill router จะถูกแนบไปกับทุก request ที่ถูก proxy — Hermes, เครื่องมือ CLI, ทุก client. Agent เลือก skill ที่จะดึง; ข้อความ skill เต็มไม่ถูกฝังใน system prompt

The skill router below ships verbatim in.de: Der Skill-Router unten wird unverändert in den System-Prompt des Modells geschickt. Er sagt dem Agent, welche Security-Skills von dieser Gateway wo geholt werden sollen. Prüfe Ziele + Scope vor der Aktivierung.

The skill router below ships verbatim in.tr: Aşağıdaki skill router olduğu gibi modelin system prompt'una gönderilir. Ajanın bu gateway'den hangi güvenlik skill'lerini, nereden çekeceğini söyler. Etkinleştirmeden önce hedefleri + kapsamı gözden geçirin.
The skill router below ships verbatim in.vi: Skill router bên dưới được gửi nguyên văn vào system prompt của model. Nó cho agent biết cần lấy skill bảo mật nào từ gateway này và lấy ở đâu. Kiểm tra mục tiêu + phạm vi trước khi bật.
The skill router below ships verbatim in.th: skill router ด้านล่างถูกส่งเข้า system prompt ของโมเดลตามเนื้อหา agent ว่าจะดึง skill ความปลอดภัยใดจาก gateway นี้ และดึงจากที่ไหน ตรวจสอบเป้าหมาย + ขอบเขตก่อนเปิดใช้งาน
